a.xlink:title: Implements the worksheet file loaders/savers extracted from the wxMaxima god class.
Loads and saves worksheet files (.wxmx, .wxm, .mac/.out, .xml) for wxMaxima.
Decides whether wxMaxima can open a file it was handed, and how.
Declares SaveAsDefaults(), what the "Save As" dialog starts out with.
This file declares the class wxMaxima that contains most of the program's logic.
This file defines the class Worksheet.
The definition of the base class of all cells the worksheet consists of.
This file declares a message dialog that sends its contents to the log message sink.
This file defines the class GroupCell that bundles input and output in the worksheet.
This file declares the class wxMaximaFrame.
The header file for the xml cell parser.

The handlers that turn a chunk of data Maxima sent into a change to wxMaxima's state and worksheet.
The wxMaxima-side owner of the Maxima process and its control socket.

Appends Maxima's (and wxMaxima's own) output to the worksheet.
Declares MaximaInterruptChannel, the connection wxMaxima interrupts Maxima through.
This file declares the class DirStructure.
